title: Mediterranean Chickpea & Bread Salad (Fattoush) with Feta Dressing

steps.text: Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.

Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut each pita in half horizontally to separate the two sides; cut or tear the bread into bite-sized pieces, place on a large baking sheet pan, and spread out in an even layer.
Drizzle oil over the pita and sprinkle with Italian seasoning and salt. Gently toss to combine, then spread back out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, tossing halfway through, until pita chips are crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add yogurt, water, vinegar, sugar, Dijon, and spices to the bowl with the garlic; whisk until smooth. Add feta and stir to combine the dressing; set aside.
Transfer chickpeas to a large bowl. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and stir to combine.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and thinly slice cucumbers. Trim and thinly slice radishes. Transfer both to the bowl with the chickpeas.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; shave parsley leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl.
Add pita chips to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Spoon dressing on top and enjoy!
